readout_other: hippocampal EEG seizure-like event metrics (interevent duration, SLE duration, spike frequency); head-fixation training sessions; cresyl violet histology
direction_notes: In one example, low-pressure contralateral FUS increased interevent duration and slightly decreased spike frequency during stimulation, but the authors call the effects modest and possibly not biologically relevant.

exposures.label: Low (0.2 MPa, 50% DC) and High (1.0 MPa, 10% DC) parameter sets; bilateral and contralateral hippocampal targets

target.label: bilateral and contralateral hippocampi relative to the kainic acid injection site

timing.protocol_description: 500 Hz PRF pulse trains of 0.2 s repeated with an interpulse train interval of 1.8 s, delivered for a 40-minute stimulation session with 1 h EEG before and after.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Two mice from the IHK group met this criterion for inclusion.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A 500-kHz single-element spherical-focused transducer (18-0018-P, Olympus) was employed for all trials.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The FUS stimulation parameter sets used are displayed in Table 1. The low-pressure parameter set used a carrier frequency of 500 kHz, amplitude or pressure of 0.2 MPa, a pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 500 Hz, a duty cycle (DC) of 50%, a pulse train interval of 0.2 s, an interpulse train interval of 1.8 s, a Mechanical Index (MI) of 0.28, a spatial peak pulse average intensity (I<sub>SPTA</sub>) of 1.33 mW/ cm<sup>2</sup>, and a spatial peak temporal average intensity (I<sub>SPTA</sub>) of 66.67 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> (Table 1, Low). The high-pressure parameter set used a carrier frequency of 500 kHz, amplitude or pressure of 1.0 MPa, a PRF of 500 Hz, a DC of 10%, a pulse train interval of 0.2 s, an interpulse train interval of 1.8 s, an MI of 1.41, an I<sub>SPTA</sub> of 3.33 mW/ cm<sup>2</sup>, and an I<sub>SPTA</sub> of 333.33 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> (Table 1, High).

flags.reason: Text gives I_SPPA in mW/cm2 (1.33, 3.33) but the Table 1 column header gives W/cm2; recorded the table unit. Values do not obviously agree with the stated pressure and duty cycle.
Table 1 and text give I_SPTA in mW/cm2 (66.67, 333.33); converted to W/cm2.

Table calls 0.2 s the 'pulse train interval'; the Figure 10 legend calls it the pulse train duration of 200 ms, which was recorded as the sonication (train) duration. Pulse duration not stated; not computed.
Two target conditions (bilateral and contralateral to the injection site) both at hippocampus, and two pressure/duty-cycle sets, were listed in one exposure. Only 2 mice were stimulated.
17 mice had surgery; only 2 IHK mice received FUS (proof-of-principle).
